name: FroDock via published PINDER methods adapter

software_pin.reason: Mirror content hash is immutable identification of supplied copy, not verification against original study distribution.

dockerfile_RUN_commands:
apt-get --allow-releaseinfo-change update 
    && apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends 
    apt-utils 
    dialog 2>&1 
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 
    git 
    rsync 
    ssh 
    gpg 
    wget 
    man-db 
    procps 
    tree 
    unzip 
    gcc 
    build-essential 
    lsb-release 
    curl 
    vim 
    exuberant-ctags 
    apt-transport-https 
    ca-certificates 
    gnupg 
    libgl1-mesa-glx  
    libopenblas-base 
    libopenmpi-dev openmpi-common openmpi-bin libopenmpi3 
    libfftw3-3 libfftw3-dev libfftw3-mpi-dev 
    libhdf5-openmpi-dev 
    && apt-get autoclean 
    && apt-get autoremove 
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

micromamba install -y -n base -c conda-forge 
    pyopenssl=23.2.0 
    python=${MAMBA_PYTHON_VERSION} 
    requests=2.25.1 
    google-cloud-storage 
    gcsfs 
    keyrings.google-artifactregistry-auth 
    && micromamba clean --all --yes

echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] http://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" | tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list && curl https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | apt-key --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg  add - && apt-get update -y && apt-get install google-cloud-cli -y

python -m pip install 
    simple-gcp-object-downloader 
    kubernetes 
    pandas==1.5.3

git clone https://github.com/pinder-org/pinder.git; 
    cd pinder && pip install .

tar -xf frodock.tar.gz && 
    mv frodock3_linux64 frodock && 
    rm frodock.tar.gz
build_commands.context: Commands transcribed from published recipe; never executed. All RUN instructions included, including package installs. Dockerfile clones moving main: reproduction must use recorded source commit; published recipe is not itself fully pinned. FroDock mirror local filename must match frodock.tar.gz. Unresolved recipe defects recorded below.

run_commands.published_template: pinder_methods predict -m <method> -s <test set> -l <list of PINDER ids> -c `config` -r `results_dir`

real_cli_interface.preprocessing_function: pinder.methods.main.preprocess(method, data_dir, subset, ids, config, pairs)
real_cli_interface.prediction_function: pinder.methods.main.predict(method, results_dir, data_dir, subset, ids, config, pairs)
real_cli_interface.note: Published short-option template is documented; Fire exposes function arguments. Predict reads setup CSV; preprocessing needed first. CLI execution untested.

template_bindings.pre: Path(frodock_mpi_gcc).parent, as published; missing separator remains unresolved

published_configuration.n_solutions_reason: Required adapter parameter without published default in inspected source. Intake chooses five retained solutions, not a claimed study value.
published_configuration.force_reason: Required config key; no published experimental setting established.

intake_configuration.reason: Fixed full paired-apo subset; five retained candidates supports published top-5 scoring and top-1 comparison. No search over scales.

unresolved_execution_issues: Source adapter has unresolved execution issues: pd.from_csv, absent copy of input PDBs into temporary directory, concatenated Path prefix without slash, literal wildcard passed to shutil.copy, subprocess return codes unchecked. Dockerfile has inconsistent archive working directory and binary PATH. No build or workload executed.
